ports.text: Islands, lemur forest and ylang-ylang country.
A vast bay, red rock formations and mountain rainforest.

items.title: Nosy Iranja By Speedboat
items.text: Walk the white sandbar, swim and snorkel with turtles.

items.title: Nosy Tanikely Snorkel
items.text: Calm reef snorkelling in a marine park, with a beach stop.

items.title: Lokobe Forest And Hell-Ville
items.text: Look for lemurs with a guide, then browse the town market.

items.title: Ylang-Ylang And Mount Passot
items.text: A working distillery and a sunset-worthy viewpoint over crater lakes.

items.title: Emerald Sea And Sugar Loaf
items.text: A boat across Diego Bay with swimming in shallow, bright water.

items.title: Red Tsingy And Old Town
items.text: Sculpted red rock formations, then a walk through Diego Suarez.

items.title: Amber Mountain Rainforest
items.text: Waterfalls, crater lakes and chameleons in a cool mountain park.

faqs.q: What if my ship is late?
faqs.a: Tell us your ship and arrival time when booking. We follow the schedule and adjust the start of your excursion.

faqs.q: Can I book once I am on board?
faqs.a: Booking ahead is safer, since vehicles and guides are limited on busy port days.
Yes. We can arrange private groups from a family up to a large party. Contact us with your numbers.
